payload.big_idea:
INHERITS the first pass (evidence/draft_vision-1.json, now superseded) and se.vision. The idea is unchanged; ONE THING IS ADDED that the first pass could not know.

UNCHANGED: the machine asks the agent to vouch for its own work, and hands it tools poor enough that the honest path runs outside the lane. i12 inverts both.

ADDED BY THE REWALK, and it sharpens the whole iteration: the first pass discovered that guidance and scans were written but never collected. The REWALK discovered that the same is true of THE REVIEW ITSELF. se.meth-gate-review has required verify / validate / redteam / verdict since it was written, no evidence form ever collected them, and consequently not one had been filled in any gate of any iteration. So the missing collection is not a quirk of two mechanisms — it is the shape of the defect, and the review rounds were its most expensive instance, because they are the check that would have caught the others.
payload.to_be_world:
INHERITS the first pass. One scene is added, and it is the one that matters most.

AN AGENT REACHES A GATE. Its evidence form asks for the gate's own acceptance items — and then for four more things it cannot skip. VERIFY: it opens what each input state's evidence points at and reads it against the claim, because a bless is not proof. VALIDATE: it reads the work against the REQUIREMENT REGISTER, not merely against its own plan, and lists what is missing, wrong or out of scope. RED-TEAM: it writes the strongest case AGAINST its own conclusion, cites the criteria rather than vibes, names the kill-criterion, and looks for it. VERDICT: pass, pass-with-overrides, or REOPEN — and reopen now does something, because the machine can carry it out.

And when the verdict IS reopen, the named states and their whole downstream cone come back to life, with the first pass's fills marked superseded rather than erased — so a reader can see what was claimed the first time and that it did not survive review.
payload.goal_system:
INHERITS G1-G4 unchanged (lane wins on merit; what can be computed is computed; every rule reaches the agent it binds; the record survives carelessness), with their three named conflicts and ruled priority order.

ONE GOAL IS ADDED, and on the rewalk's evidence it outranks the rest:

G5 A REVIEW HAPPENS BECAUSE SOMETHING ASKS FOR IT. Every check the method requires is collected by an evidence form. A required check that no form collects is not a weak check — it is an absent one, and it will read as present forever.

CONFLICT, named openly: G5 versus G1 (the lane is the path of least resistance). Four mandatory rounds on every gate is real friction, and a gate that is genuinely trivial now costs the same as one that is not. RULED, following v1's rubric rather than inventing: SCALE TO SIZE — do not red-team a trivial gate — but SAY SO IN THE ROUND rather than leaving it blank. A one-line 'this gate is mechanical, no opposing case exists' is a review; an empty field is not.

PRIORITY ORDER, amended: G5 FIRST, above G2. The first pass put G2 (compute what can be computed) at the top and still shipped a violated requirement, because the thing that catches a violated requirement is not a lint — it is a human-or-agent reading the register against the work. G5 is what makes every other goal checkable.
payload.moore_pitch:
FOR the agent walking the loop and the owner who must own its output,
WHO need the lane to be worth using and its gates worth trusting,
THE tool surface and the machine's own review
ARE a working environment whose gates REVIEW THEMSELVES — reads that reach anywhere by name, searches that see the tree and the record, batched edits, lints for the mechanical half, and four mandatory rounds of increasing scrutiny that no gate can pass without,
THAT lets the agent stay inside the lane because it is the fastest way to work, and lets a self-blessed killer rest on a review that actually happened rather than on a procedure that looked like one,
UNLIKE today, where the lane cannot open the two documents the process requires, the most-used tool applies one edit per call, four laws minted this afternoon will never reach a packet — and every gate in the project's history was blessed without a single one of the four review rounds its own method has always required.
